name: Bundle QR Payments for UPI
author: BundleWP

sections.description:
Bundle QR Payments for UPI lets your WooCommerce store accept UPI payments directly — no payment gateway account, no onboarding approval, no per-transaction commission to a gateway.

At checkout, your customer sees a QR code generated for the exact order amount. They scan it with any UPI app (Google Pay, PhonePe, Paytm, BHIM and others), pay, and enter their 12-digit UTR number on the confirmation page. You verify the UTR in your own UPI or banking app and complete the order. Simple, direct, and made for Indian stores that want to start taking online payments today.

Features

  • Dynamic QR code per order — carries the exact amount and order number
  • Works with every UPI app: GPay, PhonePe, Paytm, BHIM and more
  • Static QR mode — use your own uploaded QR image instead
  • UTR capture on the confirmation page, stored on the order with a private order note
  • UTR shown in the admin order panel so verification takes seconds
  • Payment instructions added automatically to the customer order email
  • “Tap to pay” link on mobile that opens the customer’s UPI app directly
  • Copy button for your UPI ID on the payment box
  • Works with the classic checkout and the WooCommerce Checkout block
  • HPOS (High-Performance Order Storage) compatible
  • You choose the order status orders wait at until you verify payment
  • No external service, no account, no fees — payments go straight to your UPI ID

How it works

  1. You enter your UPI ID (VPA) in the gateway settings.
  2. A customer checks out and scans the QR code with their UPI app.
  3. After paying, the customer submits their 12-digit UTR number.
  4. You check the UTR in your UPI/bank app and mark the order complete.

sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/, or install it through the WordPress plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin.
  3. Go to WooCommerce → Settings → Payments → Bundle QR Payments for UPI.
  4. Enter your UPI ID (VPA) and payee name, keep the Dynamic QR mode, and save.
  5. Place a test order to see your QR code at checkout.
sections.faq:
Do I need a payment gateway account?

No. Payments go directly to your UPI ID. There is no gateway approval, no paperwork and no gateway commission.

Which UPI apps work?

All of them. The QR code follows the standard UPI format, so Google Pay, PhonePe, Paytm, BHIM and any other UPI app can scan and pay it.

How do I confirm a customer actually paid?

After paying, the customer submits their 12-digit UTR (transaction reference) number on the confirmation page. It is saved on the order and shown in the admin order panel — open your UPI or banking app, match the UTR and amount, then complete the order.

Can I use my own QR image instead?

Yes. Switch the QR code type to “Static” in the settings and upload your QR image. Note that a static QR cannot carry the order amount, so customers type the amount themselves.

Does it work with the Checkout block and HPOS?

Yes. Bundle QR Payments for UPI registers a payment method for the WooCommerce Checkout block and declares compatibility with High-Performance Order Storage.

Does the plugin send any data to external servers?

No. QR codes are generated in the customer’s browser, and payments happen directly between the customer’s UPI app and your UPI ID.
sections.changelog:
1.1.0

  • FIX: The gateway now appears in the WooCommerce Checkout BLOCK (it was missing there and only worked in the classic shortcode checkout). The Blocks payment method registration is no longer tied solely to the ‘woocommerce_blocks_loaded’ action, which WooCommerce fires before most plugins load.
  • NEW: A fixed BundleWP Products bar now sits at the top of your WordPress Dashboard home — an auto-scrolling showcase of all 10 BundleWP products with the SAVE70 coupon offer. The bar is always visible on the Dashboard (it cannot be dismissed or hidden), and if you run more than one BundleWP plugin, it appears only once.
  • BundleWP Products page: added FoodFleet (restaurant website system) and ShopKart (e-commerce website system).

1.0.3

  • New: “BundleWP Products” page under the WooCommerce menu — all BundleWP products in a card layout with the SAVE70 coupon offer, same as our Notification Bar plugin.
  • Added the plugin icon and banner on WordPress.org.

1.0.2

  • Renamed to “Bundle QR Payments for UPI” following the WordPress.org review team’s suggestion for a distinctive name (UPI placed after “for”). No functional changes.

1.0.1

  • Renamed to “QRNest for UPI” (interim name, superseded during review). No functional changes.

1.0.0

  • Initial release: dynamic and static UPI QR payments for WooCommerce, UTR capture, admin order panel, customer email instructions, Checkout block support and HPOS compatibility.
